title: Spectrum 227kg-Capacity Poly Tipping-Cart / Wheelbarrow | SP22111
description: Spectrum SP22111 Poly Tipping Cart/Wheelbarrow If you regularly need to transport heavy or bulky loads - up to 227kg - around the yard or garden, then the Spectrum SP22111 will prove the perfect work partner! Its corrosion-resistant polypropylene deck ensures you'll get year upon year of rust-free service; its large, 406mm-diameter pneumatic tyres mean that difficult terrain will not prove a problem. The practical and convenient Spectrum SP22111 Poly Cart boasts a foot-pedal tipping mechanism, which makes unloading the contents quick and easy. The wheels on this model are equipped with grease zerks and needle bearings for a long life and simple maintenance. Compatible with all makes and models of tow-capable garden tractor. Please note: this product can also be used as a push cart - simply fold away the towing arm.
feature_2: Polypropylene bed for a lengthy service life
feature_3: Pneumatic tyres for superior rough-ground stability
feature_4: Needle bearings with grease zerks for easy maintenance
